name: PER_JOB_EVALUATIONS_
description: PER_JOB_EVALUATIONS holds the schemes and systems that the Enterprise uses to evaluate the jobs and positions stored in PER_JOBS_F and HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F. For each one, either the JOB_ID column or the POSITION_ID column will be populated, but not both.

columns.name: JOB_EVALUATION_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_JOBS_F table.

columns.name: POSITION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HR_ALL_POSITIONS_F table.

columns.name: EVALUATION_SYSTEM
columns.description: Evaluation system used for jobs or positions, for example Hay System.

columns.name: DATE_EVALUATED
columns.description: Date of the evaluation.

columns.name: MEASURED_IN
columns.description: Measurement unit for the evaluation, for example points.

columns.name: OVERALL_SCORE
columns.description: Total number of points for the seeded hay evaluation system.

columns.name: ACCOUNTABILITY
columns.description: Accountability is a seeded criterion for the hay evaluation system.

columns.name: KNOWHOW
columns.description: Knowhow is a seeded criterion for the hay evaluation system.

columns.name: PROBLEM_SOLVING
columns.description: Problem Solving is a seeded criterion for the hay evaluation system.

columns.name: WORKING_CONDITIONS
columns.description: Working Conditions is a seeded criterion for the hay evaluation system.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Who column: indicates the impersonator who last updated the row.
